description: "Hymns and Poems" by A. L. O. E. is a collection of hymns and religious poetry likely written in the late 19th century. The compilation emphasizes themes of faith, hope, and divine love, while also addressing various aspects of human experience, particularly in relation to hardship and spiritual growth.
